title: findings.json record
description: One record of findings.json: an open finding, a rejected record, or a fixed record. The document skeleton around the arrays (kind, repo_id, run_id, summary, ...) is defined in references/data-schema.md; validate_findings.py checks this schema's enums against its own constants. Id F-NNNN is the primary key; the fingerprint format is <path>::<symbol>::<slug>.

id.description: Primary key: unique within a snapshot, stable across snapshots for the same root cause.

fingerprint.description: <path>::<symbol>::<slug>; repo-relative path, enclosing symbol, 2-5-word root-cause slug.

previous_fingerprints.description: Old fingerprints of a moved finding, oldest first.

trace_paths.description: trace-changed watches these paths between verdict_source_ref and the working tree.

exploitation_path.description: Open findings only; required for confirmed/likely.

status.description: Open-finding branch only; rejected and fixed records live in their own arrays.

severity.description: Present iff status is confirmed or likely (disputed findings may carry a provisional severity).

disputed.description: Second-verifier disagreement; requires verifier_reasons (>= 2, both positions verbatim).

validated_in_context.description: True when this record's verdict was produced in the orchestrator's context instead of by an isolated verifier (linear mode, or a medium/low finding verified in-context after two failed verifier launches). A rejected or fixed record with this flag must carry a provisional severity of medium or low.

owner_assumptions.description: User-supplied or deployment facts the verdict rests on; rendered in REPORT.md.

missing_fact.description: Non-empty exactly when reason_code is missing_fact.

verdict_date.description: Never changes when a rejected record is carried into a newer snapshot.

verdict_source_ref.description: Commit hex, never a branch name or HEAD.

reason.description: Rejected branch: the refutation. Fixed branch: omitted (evidence carries the closure).

merged_from.description: Board candidate ids that deduped into this record; every board id maps to exactly one bucket.
